Messages.Author: reyda
Messages.Body:
Chris Shorb wrote:
> Jaroslav's Special says he can do 1 pt to each Sabbat vamp of prey.
> I assume this means that he takes 1 action, and every prey's sabbat
> vamp takes takes a damage?

excuse me but what's the point in putting "concealed weapon" in the title
??? =)

Jaroslav can take the action to do 1 damage to all your prey's sabbat vamp.
If this action is blocked, of course there is no damage done (except to the
poor blocker i guess ;) )
